completed_missions.title: Build persistent 11-agent Hixton swarm
completed_missions.result: Eleven role contracts, persistent knowledge, regression protocol and GitHub-hosted cloud orchestration were established. Legacy laptop-bound engineering launchers and local agent runners were removed.

completed_missions.title: Complete USDT to USDC migration audit, explain backtest delta, repair defects, retest
completed_missions.result: The complete A01-A11 chain passed after repairs. No supported USDT-to-USDC strategy/code defect explains the historic 733-versus-about-203 difference. The dominant difference is the non-equivalent account path: the old USDT reference carried prior equity/positions into the later period, while the later USDT/USDC controls restarted fresh. On the same fresh-start window USDC slightly outperformed USDT. Persistent portfolio drawdown/risk halting explains most rejected entries on the fresh path. Paper/shared-portfolio parity matched exactly under equivalent assumptions.

active_mission.title: 15-coin gap-filler and capital-layout candidate audit
active_mission.objective: Find the best modular shared-capital layout for the 15-market Hixton candidate without degrading the proven 10-coin Core. Compare 2/3/4/5 slots at fixed total capital, including true 5x50 one_per_symbol at 250 USDC, verify scaling at 1000 USDC, keep Core priority, and optimize AAVE/SUI/UNI only for genuine Core-idle gap filling while retaining NEAR/BCH unless evidence rejects them.
active_mission.last_transition_reason: Owner requested independent A01-A11 review of slot architecture and five-Satellite gap-filler integration before any product promotion.
constraints: Protected gpt/usdc-audit product behavior is the incumbent and must not be silently modified by this candidate audit.
The ten Core coins retain absolute priority over Satellites. Satellites may fill only genuine Core-idle capacity and must yield required slots at the next executable open.
Total configured capital is fixed per comparison; slot layout is the controlled variable. No leverage and no hidden increase in capital.
At 250 USDC compare 2x125, 3x~83.33, 4x62.50 and 5x50. Include a true 5x50 one_per_symbol layout as well as ranked_repeat variants.
At 1000 USDC verify the same candidate layouts scale from configured max capital rather than fixed 125/50 constants.
All five Satellites remain in the 15-coin research universe. Shared activation is evidence-gated; current incumbent subset is NEAR+BCH.
AAVE is the first inactive Satellite to optimize for preemption-aware gaps; SUI and UNI require short-gap redesign. Trade count alone is never an acceptance criterion.
Coin-profile search and slot-layout search are separate causal experiments. Do not change both in the same comparison.
Baseline and stress costs, same exact history, drawdown, PnL, NO_FREE_SLOT blocks, zero/partial/full occupancy, slot utilization, holding time and per-coin contribution are mandatory.
Training may select candidates. Validation/full-window evidence may reject but may not invent a new winner post hoc.
No Paper/Live activation, no private Binance credentials, no real/testnet orders.
acceptance: A01 verifies the objective, invariants, 15-market universe, Core-vs-Satellite separation and experiment ledger are explicit and non-contradictory.
A02 reproduces exact controlled slot-layout evidence at 250 USDC for 2/3/4/5 slots and true 5x50 one_per_symbol, then checks modular scaling at 1000 USDC.

A02 reports baseline/stress PnL, return, drawdown, completed trades, slot trades, fees, holding time, NO_FREE_SLOT blocks and zero/partial/full slot occupancy for Core10, Core+NEAR/BCH and Core+all-five.
A03 verifies Backtest/Paper/Live can derive slot size from configured max capital and flags any fixed 125/50 assumption or strategy/runtime mismatch.
A04 verifies no misleading UI/product claim presents research slot layouts or inactive Satellites as already promoted.
A05 quantifies Core slot saturation, completely idle time, partial occupancy and whether long holds create opportunity loss under each layout.
A06 runs regression checks after router/allocator changes and proves the default 2-slot behavior remains unchanged when the new research parameter is omitted.
A07 confirms exchange minimums/filters remain compatible with 50-USDC tranches for all 15 USDC targets and flags layouts that become invalid at smaller tranche sizes.
A08 evaluates drawdown, concentration, repeated-slot risk, Core preemption cost and whether 5x50 or another layout improves risk-adjusted shared performance rather than merely trade count.
A08 separately reviews NEAR, BCH, AAVE, SUI and UNI contribution under the winning layout and proposes bounded preemption-aware changes for inactive Satellites.
A10 synthesizes all specialist evidence and recommends retain 2x125 or a different slot architecture with explicit reasons and named blockers.
A09 emits QA_PASS only on one exact candidate commit after static/tests/backtest evidence is fresh and comparable.
A11 emits GOVERNANCE_PASS only after fresh QA_PASS and rejects any conclusion based on stale/mixed commits, headline return alone or trade count alone.
No result is promoted to gpt/usdc-audit or activated in Paper/Live as part of this research round.
